summary.en: A guess lands with its dot; the word shrinks into the dot, which bursts into particles that condense into the method word.
summary.zh: 一个“猜”字带着墨点落下；字缩进墨点，墨点炸成粒子，再聚成方法那个词。

fits: The turn from a wrong approach to the right one: guess → halve, manual → automatic.
notFor: long words; two unrelated words (the burst says one became the other).

intent.en: The method is born out of the guess: the same ink, rearranged.
intent.zh: 方法从猜测里生出来：同一滴墨，重新排列。

fits.zh: 从错误做法转到正确做法：猜 → 二分，手动 → 自动。

notFor.zh: 长词；两个无关的词（炸开表示一个变成了另一个）。

en: The burst is runtime collapse-burst: keep both words short enough to fit centred at one size.
zh: 炸开用运行时的 collapse-burst：两个词要短到能用同一字号居中放下。

overlaps.note: runtime hand-off used unchanged; this scene places the words and times it

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
